observations.value: ProxyPanel is a Rust workspace implementing a Hub-Agent proxy node management panel (Hub HTTP+gRPC, node Agent driving sing-box/mihomo, React web panel, Tauri client, admin CLI).
HEAD is 1bf847a30fd6436bf4e2f632d37d3e09a308ec30; the working tree is dirty (AGENTS.md carries an uncommitted 'Agent Development Protocol' section; root ADOPT.md is untracked).
observations.notes: The protocol section and root ADOPT.md exist only in the working tree, not in the audited revision.

observations.value: Agent Development Protocol is consumed as a submodule at .protocol/agent-development-protocol, pinned by gitlink to 310fba5baa384c912e1fd8300e33d72a057908c5, protocol version 0.1.0; submodule working tree is clean.

Cargo workspace has 13 members (pp-common, pp-db, pp-proto, pp-config, pp-subscription, pp-script, pp-core, pp-hub, pp-agent, pp-cli, pp-mitm, pp-client, pp-client-tauri); edition 2024, rust-version 1.88. Frontends (apps/panel, apps/client, packages/*) are Bun workspace members, not cargo members.

Hub exposes REST + gRPC bidi stream; Agent manages sing-box/mihomo processes and connects over gRPC; pp-config translates ProtocolConfig + NodeBinding into core JSON/YAML; pp-subscription generates subscription formats.

Client is a single Tauri app apps/client (desktop + Android targets) per ADR-0007, with sources apps/client/src/desktop and apps/client/src/mobile, an independent cargo shell apps/client/src-tauri, shared crate crates/pp-client-tauri and shared frontend library packages/client-core.
Project documentation and agent infrastructure still describe the pre-ADR-0007 split (apps/desktop + apps/mobile), contradicting ADR-0007 and the actual apps/ tree.
observations.notes: README.md:70 and README.md:262 are current (apps/client) while README.md:235-236 are stale — the contradiction is intra-document as well.

observations.value: Documented and scripted commands: cargo build/test/clippy/fmt; bun install at repo root (single bun.lock); bun run verify:rust (scripts/check-rust-gates.sh) and verify:rust:fast; per-app verify (pp-web, pp-client-app, @pp/client-core).

CI runs three jobs: rust (fmt --check, clippy --workspace -D warnings, cargo test --workspace), client-shells (host clippy of apps/client/src-tauri and aarch64-linux-android cargo check), web (panel verify, client-core verify, client app verify incl. desktop+android builds). Release workflow has web, build and desktop-windows jobs.
Husky pre-commit enforces file-size guard, cargo fmt --check plus fast Rust compile gate for staged Rust files, and oxlint/oxfmt for staged frontend files.

83 Rust source files contain inline #[cfg(test)] modules; documentation covers unit/DB/gRPC testing; crates/pp-client/tests/real_core_e2e.rs is an ignored, manually run end-to-end test requiring a real sing-box binary.
No frontend test runner or test script exists in apps/panel, apps/client or packages/client-core; their verify script is build + lint + format only.

AGENTS.md:373-381 states integration tests are not set up and plan a tests/ directory, but crates/pp-client/tests/real_core_e2e.rs already exists and docs/development.md's testing section documents only Rust unit/DB tests.
Atomic-commit and Conventional Commits rules, PR flow, reviewer guidance and release steps are documented in AGENTS.md §5 and docs/contributing.md.
File-size thresholds (400 warn / 500 fail for business sources, 1000 for tests) are defined in .agents/rules/code-organization.md and enforced by scripts/check-file-size.sh in the pre-commit hook.

Project documentation lives in docs/: index.md, architecture.md, development.md, deployment.md, api_reference.md, contributing.md, adr/0001-0007, plans/, research/. There is no docs/README.md, docs/architecture/, docs/workflows/, docs/testing/, docs/decisions/, docs/adapters/ or docs/adoption/ before this audit.

observations.value: AGENTS.md:186 and AGENTS.md:352 reference only proto/hub_agent.proto, but proto/ also contains singbox_daemon.proto which crates/pp-proto/build.rs compiles.
AGENTS.md §4.1 documents AppState with only db and agents, while crates/pp-hub/src/state.rs declares db, config, rate_limiter, agents, metrics_handle, api_key_cache and binary_waiters.

Seven ADRs under docs/adr/ use a common Status/Date/Deciders/Scope header; ADR-0007 (Accepted) supersedes ADR-0003 (Status: Superseded by ADR-0007). No ADR index, template or documented ADR convention exists.
ADR-0002 still has Status: Proposed although its own §8.2 records the v1 implementation as complete; ADR-0006 is dated 2026-12-19, later than ADR-0007 dated 2026-10-03 despite the lower number.

An opencode adapter is configured: opencode.jsonc defines orchestrator/executor/reviewer agents with models and permissions; .opencode/ holds AGENTS.md, three agent prompt files and rules/coding-standards.md; .opencode/AGENTS.md still contains an unfilled placeholder for the project stack.
observations.notes: .opencode/rules/coding-standards.md:6-14 still points verification commands at apps/desktop.

observations.value: A pi adapter is configured: .pi/master.md orchestrator prompt, .pi/agents/{coder,reviewer,writer}.md with front-matter (model, tools, skills), .pi/subagent-isolation.json model map, .pi/skills/ skill set and .pi/plans/ plans referencing apps/desktop.

Project-scoped agent rules live in .agents/rules/ (code-organization, data-migration, package-manager, client-state-management) and bundled skills in .agents/skills/ (heroui-react, heroui-native, heroui-migration) with skills-lock.json; apps/panel/AGENTS.md is a generated HeroUI docs index.
No docs/adapters/ directory or adapter documentation exists; there is no documented mapping of supported coding agents to workflows, permissions, or conformance evidence.
The product contains no AI/LLM agent runtime: crates/pp-agent is a Rust proxy-core process manager communicating over gRPC, and the workspace has no LLM client dependency.
observations.notes: The name 'Agent' in pp-agent denotes a proxy node daemon, not an AI agent.

observations.value: No MCP server or client integration exists: no MCP configuration in opencode.jsonc or .opencode/, and no docs/mcp/. apps/panel/AGENTS.md only lists HeroUI's own mcp-server.mdx documentation entry.

No application-level prompt management or agent memory subsystem exists. State-related material is application state (frontend Jotai/Zustand per .agents/rules/client-state-management.md; Sea-ORM persistence per docs/architecture.md §数据库设计).

Operations are substantively documented: docs/deployment.md covers Docker Compose, reverse proxy, CLI lifecycle install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall/status/logs, one-click node install, manual systemd deployment, HA, TLS/token security, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, backup/restore, upgrades and troubleshooting; install scripts, Dockerfiles, compose file and release workflow exist.
No adoption record existed before this audit: docs/adoption/ did not exist, and no project-inventory.json, protocol-mapping.json or adoption report was present anywhere in the project tree.
